rows.hypothesis: coherence baskets that are not executable as taker can be built by resting a bid on one leg and hedging the others as taker when it fills (maker pays 0 fee)
rows.rule: At poll T: for each risk-free relation choose the leg with the largest planned margin m = minPay - bid - sum(other asks + fee); if m > theta rest a bid (join best bid or improve 1 tick) for H s; cancel at any later poll where the basket is no longer profitable; fills from the real taker tape after T; hedge at the next recorded book.
